source: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.
reference: Mambo hayakwenda vizuri kwa Waitaliano katika Afrika Kaskazini tangu karibu mwanzoni. Ndani ya wiki tangu Italia kutangaza vita mnamo Juni 10, 1940, Hussar wa 11 wa Kiingereza walikuwa wameteka Ngome ya Kapuzo huko Libya.
hypothesis: Mambo hayakuenda vizuri kwa Waitaliano katika Afrika Kaskazini karibu tangu mwanzo. Ndani ya juma moja baada ya Italia kutangaza vita mnamo Juni 10, 1940, Waingereza wa 11 Hussars walikuwa wameteka Fort Capuzzo huko Libya.

source: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.
reference: Katika shambulizi mashariki mwa Bardia, Wazungu walimkamata Mhandisi Mkuu wa Jeshi la Kumi la Kiitaliano, Jenerali Lastucci.
hypothesis: Katika mtego upande wa mashariki wa Bardia, Waingereza walimkamata Mhandisi Mkuu wa Jeshi la Kumi la Italia, Jenerali Lastucci.

source: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.
reference: Mnamo Juni 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, Gavana Mkuu wa Libya na mrithi dhahiri wa Mussolini, aliuawa kimakosa alipokuwa akitua huko Tobruk.
hypothesis: Mnamo Juni 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, Gavana Mkuu wa Libya na mrithi wa Mussolini, aliuawa na risasi ya kirafiki wakati wa kutua Tobruk.

source: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.
reference: Mchezo wa kisasa wa kupigana kwa sime huchezwa kwa viwango vingi, toka wanafunzi wanaosoma katika chuo kikuu hadi mashindano ya kitaalamu na Olimpiki.
hypothesis: Michezo ya kisasa ya ngome huchezwa katika ngazi nyingi, kuanzia wanafunzi wanaojifunza katika chuo kikuu hadi mashindano ya kitaalamu na ya Olimpiki.

source: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.
reference: Mchezo huo huchezwa kimsingi kwa muundo wa kupigana, mchezaji mmoja akipigana na mwingine.
hypothesis: Michezo hiyo huchezwa hasa katika mfumo wa dueling, mlinzi mmoja akishindana na mwingine.

source: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.
reference: Gofu ni mchezo ambao wachezaji hutumia rungu kuingiza mipira mashimoni.
hypothesis: Gofu ni mchezo ambao wachezaji hutumia mbao kupiga mipira kwenye mashimo.

source: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.
reference: Mashimo kumi na manane huchezwa wakati wa duru ya kawaida, na wachezaji kawaida huanzia shimo la kwanza kwenye uwanja na kumalizia kwenye shimo la kumi na nane.
hypothesis: Hole kumi na nane huchezwa wakati wa raundi ya kawaida, na wachezaji kawaida huanza kwenye shimo la kwanza kwenye uwanja na kumaliza kwenye ya kumi na nane.

source: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.
reference: Mchezaji ambaye hufanya mipigo michache zaidi, au mizunguko ya rungu, kukamilisha mkondo hushinda.
hypothesis: Mchezaji anayepiga shambulio dogo zaidi, au shambulio la klabu, ili kukamilisha kozi anashinda.

source: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
reference: Mchezo huo huchezwa kwenye nyasi, na nyasi zilizo karibu na shimo hukatwa ziwe fupi na huitwa kijani kibichi.
hypothesis: Mchezo huo huchezwa kwenye nyasi, na nyasi zinazozunguka shimo hilo hukatwa fupi na kuitwa kijani kibichi.

source: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.
reference: Pengine aina ya kawaida zaidi ya utalii ni ambayo watu wengi huhusisha na usafiri: Utalii wa burudani.
hypothesis: Labda aina ya utalii ya kawaida zaidi ni ile ambayo watu wengi huhusianisha na kusafiri: utalii wa burudani.

source: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.
reference: Huu ni wakati watu wanaenda mahali ambapo ni tofauti sana na maisha yao ya kawaida ya kila siku kupumzika na kufurahia.
hypothesis: Hii ni wakati watu wanapoenda mahali tofauti sana na maisha yao ya kawaida ya kila siku ili kupumzika na kujifurahisha.

source: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.
reference: Pwani, bustani maalum na nyanja za kambi mara nyingi huwa sehemu ambazo hutembelewa sana na watalii wa kujiburudisha.
hypothesis: Pwani, mbuga za vitumbuizo na viwanja vya kambi mara nyingi ni mahali pa kawaida zaidi kutembelewa na watalii wa burudani.

source: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.
reference: Kama lengo la mwafulani la kutembelea mahali maalum ni kujua historia na utamaduni wake basi aina hii ya utalii inajulikana kama utalii wa kitamaduni.
hypothesis: Ikiwa lengo la mtu kutembelea mahali fulani ni kupata kujua historia na utamaduni wake basi aina hii ya utalii inajulikana kama utalii wa kitamaduni.

source: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
reference: Watalii wanaweza kutembelea alama tofauti za ardhi za nchi maalum au wanaweza tu kuchagua kuangazia eneo moja tu.
hypothesis: Watalii wanaweza kutembelea maeneo tofauti-tofauti katika nchi fulani au wanaweza kuchagua tu kukazia fikira eneo moja tu.

source: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.
reference: Wakoloni, walipoona shughuli hii, pia waliita wasaidizi.
hypothesis: Wakoloni, walipoona utendaji huo, waliomba pia waongezewe nguvu.

source: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).
reference: Majeshi yanayoimarisha nafasi za mbele ni pamoja na ya 1 na ya 3 ya majeshi ya New Hampshire yaliyo na wanaume 200, yaliyo chini ya makanali John Stark na James Reed (ambao baadaye wote walikuwa majenerali).
hypothesis: Jeshi la kuimarisha nafasi za mbele lilijumuisha kikosi cha 1 na 3 cha New Hampshire cha wanaume 200, chini ya Makolonel John Stark na James Reed (wote baadaye wakawa jenerali).

source: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.
reference: Wanaume wa Stark walichukua nafasi kando ya uzio upande wa kaskazini mwa nafasi ya Mkoloni.
hypothesis: Wanaume wa Stark walichukua msimamo kando ya uzio kwenye ncha ya kaskazini ya msimamo wa Wakoloni.

source: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.
reference: Wakati kupwa kwa maji kulifungua mwanya katika Mto Mystic katika kaskazini mashariki mwa rasi, waliendeleza ua kwa haraka kwa ukuta mfupi wa mawe upande wa kaskazini na kuishia kwenye ukingo wa maji katika pwani ndogo.
hypothesis: Mafuriko ya chini yalipofungua shimo kwenye Mto Mystic upande wa kaskazini-mashariki wa peninsula hiyo, walipanua haraka uzio huo kwa ukuta mfupi wa mawe kuelekea kaskazini na kumalizika kwenye ukingo wa maji kwenye pwani ndogo.

source: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.
reference: Gridley au Stark aliweka nguzo umbali wa kama futi 100 (mita 30) mbele ya uzio na akaamuru kwamba hakuna atakayeiwasha moto hadi watu wa kawaida watakapokuwa wameipita.
hypothesis: Gridley au Stark waliweka mti karibu mita 30 mbele ya uzio na kuamuru kwamba mtu yeyote asiwashambulie mpaka watu wa kawaida waupite.

source: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.
reference: Mpango wa Marekani ulitegemea uanzishaji wa mashambulio yaliyoratibiwa kutoka pande tatu tofauti.
hypothesis: Mpango wa Marekani ulitegemea kuzindua mashambulizi yaliyopangwa kwa upatano kutoka pande tatu tofauti.

source: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.
reference: Jenerali John Cadwalder alianzisha shambulio la kupotosha dhidi ya ngome ya Uingereza katika Bordentown, ili kuzuia usaidizi wowote.
hypothesis: Jenerali John Cadwalder angeanzisha shambulio la kugeuza msimamo dhidi ya jeshi la Uingereza huko Bordentown, ili kuzuia ongezeko lolote.

source: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.
reference: Jenerali James Ewing angewachukua wanamgambo 700 na kuvuka mto huko Kivukio cha Trenton, kutwaa kwa nguvu daraja iliyoko juu ya Asunpink Creek na kuwazuia wanamgambo wowote adui kutoroka.
hypothesis: Jenerali James Ewing angechukua wanamgambo 700 kuvuka mto huko Trenton Ferry, kukamata daraja juu ya Mto Assunpink na kuzuia majeshi yoyote ya adui kutoroka.

source: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.
reference: Kikosi kikuu cha ushambuliaji chenye wanaume 2,400 kilivuka mto maili tisa kaskazini mwa Trenton, kisha kugawanyika kwa vikundi viwili, kimoja chini ya Greene na kingine chini ya Sullivan, ili kuanzisha shambulio kabla ya macheo.
hypothesis: Kikosi kikuu cha askari 2,400 kilivuka mto kilomita tisa kaskazini mwa Trenton, kisha kikagawanyika katika vikundi viwili, kimoja chini ya utawala wa Greene na kingine chini ya utawala wa Sullivan, ili kuanza mashambulizi kabla ya mapambazuko.

source: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.
reference: Kwa mabadiliko kutoka mbio za robo hadi nusu maili, kasi huwa yenye umuhimu mdogo zaidi na ustahimilivu ukawa hitaji lenye umuhimu kabisa.
hypothesis: Baada ya kubadilika kutoka kwa mwendo wa nusu maili hadi nusu maili, kasi huwa si muhimu sana na uvumilivu huwa jambo la lazima kabisa.

source: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.
reference: Kwa kweli mkimbiaji wa daraja la kwanza wa nusu maili, mtu anayeweza kufuzu kwa dakika mbili, lazima awe na kasi ya kutosha, lakini uvumilivu lazima ustawishwe wakati wote wa hatari.
hypothesis: Bila shaka, nusu-millionaire wa darasa la kwanza, mtu anayeweza kupiga dakika mbili, lazima awe na kasi nzuri, lakini uvumilivu unapaswa kusitawishwa katika hatari zote.

source: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.
reference: Mbio kiasi za mashambani katika msimu wa baridi, pamoja na shughuli katika ukumbi wa mazoezi kwa ajili ya sehemu ya juu ya mwili, ndiyo maandalizi bora ya msimu wa mbio.
hypothesis: Kufanya mazoezi ya nchi kavu wakati wa majira ya baridi kali, pamoja na kufanya mazoezi katika sehemu ya juu ya mwili, ni maandalizi bora kwa ajili ya majira ya kukimbia.

source: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.
reference: Mazoea ya lishe sahihi pekee haiwezi kuzalisha usomi wa utendaji, ila yanaweza kuathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa na ustawi wa wakimbiaji wachanga kwa ujumla.
hypothesis: Mazoea yanayofaa ya lishe peke yake hayawezi kuzalisha utendaji bora, lakini yanaweza kuathiri sana afya ya jumla ya wanariadha vijana.

source: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.
reference: Kudumisha uwiano bora wa kawi, kuwa na mazoea ya unywaji wa maji yenye ufanisi, na kuelewa vipengele tofauti vya mazoea ya ziada kunaweza kusaidia wanariadha kuboresha utendaji wao na kuongeza raha yao katika spoti hiyo.
hypothesis: Kudumisha usawaziko mzuri wa nishati, mazoea mazuri ya kunywa maji, na kuelewa mambo mbalimbali yanayohusiana na kutumia dawa za kulevya kunaweza kuwasaidia wanariadha kuboresha utendaji wao na kuongeza kufurahia michezo yao.

source: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.
reference: Mbio za umbali wa kati ni spoti isiyo ghali sana; hata hivyo, kuna dhana nyingi potovu kuhusu zana chache zinazohitajika ili kushiriki.
hypothesis: Kukimbia kwa umbali wa kati ni mchezo wa bei rahisi; hata hivyo, kuna maoni yasiyo sahihi mengi kuhusu vifaa vichache vinavyohitajika ili kushiriki.

source: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.
reference: Bidhaa zinaweza kununuliwa zinapotakikana, lakini nyingi zitakuwa na athari ndogo au isiyo halisi kwa utendaji.
hypothesis: Bidhaa zinaweza kununuliwa kama zinavyohitajika, lakini nyingi hazitaathiri sana utendaji.

source: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.
reference: Wanariadha wanaweza kuhisi wanapendelea bidhaa hata kama haina manufaa halisi.
hypothesis: Huenda wanariadha wakahisi kwamba wanapendelea bidhaa fulani hata ikiwa haitoi faida yoyote ya kweli.

source: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.
reference: Atomu inaweza kuchukuliwa kama mojawapo ya mawe msingi ya ujenzi ya dutu zote.
hypothesis: Atomu inaweza kuonwa kuwa mojawapo ya vitu vya msingi vinavyojenga vitu vyote.

source: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.
reference: Ni chombo tata ambacho kulingana na mfano uliorahisishwa wa Bohr, kina nyuklia ya kati inayozungukwa na elektroni, sawa na sayari zinavyozunguka jua - ona Mchoro 1.1.
hypothesis: Ni kitu ngumu sana ambayo ina, kwa mujibu wa mfano Bohr rahisi, ya msingi kuzunguka electrons, kiasi sawa na sayari kuzunguka jua - angalia Kielelezo 1.1.

source: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.
reference: Nyuklia ina chembe mbili - nyutroni na protoni.
hypothesis: Nyuklia hiyo inajumuisha chembe mbili - neutroni na protoni.

source: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.
reference: Protoni zina chaji chanya ya umeme wakati neutroni hazina chaji. Elektroni zina chaji hasi ya umeme.
hypothesis: Protoni wana mzigo mzuri wa umeme wakati neutroni hawana mzigo.

source: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.
reference: Ili Kumwangalia mwathirika, ni lazima kwanza uchunguze eneo ili kuhakikisha usalama wako.
hypothesis: Ili kumtafuta mtu huyo, lazima kwanza uangalie eneo la tukio ili kuhakikisha usalama wako.

source: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.
reference: Unahitaji kugundua nafasi ya mwathiriwa unapoenda kumkaribia na kiashiria vyovyote vya kawaida vya hatari.
hypothesis: Unahitaji kutambua msimamo wa dhaifu unapomkaribia na ishara zozote nyekundu.

source: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.
reference: Ikiwa utaumia ukijaribu kusaidia, huenda utafanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi tu.
hypothesis: Ukiumia unapojaribu kusaidia, huenda ukafanya mambo yawe mabaya zaidi.

source: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.
reference: Utafiti ulionyesha kwamba mafadhaiko, uoga na kutia janga chumvi kulipatanisha uhusiano kati ya uchungu na ulemavu kwa walio na maumivu ya sehemu ya chini ya mgongo.
hypothesis: Utafiti huo uligundua kwamba kushuka moyo, woga, na kutokeza misiba vilitimiza uhusiano kati ya maumivu na ulemavu kwa wale walio na maumivu ya mgongo wa chini.

source: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.
reference: Ni athari tu za kutia janga chumvi, si mafadhaiko na uoga, zilizokuwa na masharti ya vipindi vya PA vya mara kwa mara kila wiki.
hypothesis: Ni madhara ya kuleta msiba tu, wala si kushuka moyo na woga, ambayo yalitegemea mikutano ya kawaida ya kila juma ya PA.

source: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.
reference: Walioshiriki katika shughuli za mara kwa mara walihitaji usaidizi zaidi kubainisha tofauti za uchungu sugu na hisia za usumbufu kutokana na msogeo wa kawaida wa kimwili, kuhusiana na mtazamo hasi wa uchungu.
hypothesis: Wale wanaoshiriki katika shughuli za kawaida walihitaji msaada zaidi katika suala la ufahamu hasi wa maumivu kwa kutofautisha tofauti za maumivu ya kudumu na hisia zisizofaa na harakati za kawaida za kimwili.

source: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.
reference: Uonaji, au uwezo wa kuona hutegemea viungo vya hisia vya mfumo wa kuona au macho.
hypothesis: Maono, au uwezo wa kuona, hutegemea viungo au macho ya mfumo wa kuona.

source: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.
reference: Kuna miundo tofauti ya macho, yaliyo ya utata tofauti kulingana na mahitaji ya kiumbe.
hypothesis: Kuna ujenzi mbalimbali wa macho, mbalimbali katika utata kulingana na mahitaji ya kiumbe.

source: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.
reference: Miundo tofauti ina uwezo tofauti, ni myepesi kwa masafa tofauti ya mawimbi na yana viwango tofauti vya ukali, pia inahitaji uchakataji tofauti ili kuelewa ingizo na nambari tofauti ili kufanya kazi kwa ubora.
hypothesis: Ujenzi tofauti kuwa na uwezo tofauti, ni nyeti kwa tofauti urefu wa wimbi na kuwa na ngazi tofauti ya ukali, pia wao zinahitaji usindikaji tofauti kuelewa input na idadi tofauti kufanya kazi kwa ufanisi.

source: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.
reference: Idadi ni mkusanyiko wa viumbehai wa spishi maalum ndani ya eneo fulani la kijiografia.
hypothesis: Idadi ya watu ni mkusanyiko wa viumbe wa aina fulani ndani ya eneo fulani la kijiografia.

source: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.
reference: Wakati kila mmoja katika idadi ya wakazi ni sawa kwa kuzingatia tabia fulani ya maumbile wanajulikana kama wanajinsia moja.
hypothesis: Wakati watu wote katika idadi ya watu ni sawa kuhusiana na sifa fulani phenotypic wao ni inayojulikana kama monomorphic.

source: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.
reference: Wakati watu wanaonyesha tofauti kadhaa za tabia fulani wanasemekana kuwa polimofiki.
hypothesis: Wakati watu huonyesha aina kadhaa za tabia fulani, wao ni polymorphic.

source: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.
reference: Makoloni ya siafu huandamana na kuishi katika awamu tofauti vilevile.
hypothesis: Makoloni ya chungu ya jeshi huanza kutembea na kufungiwa katika hatua mbalimbali pia.

source: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
reference: Katika awamu ya kuhamahama, siafu huandamana usiku na kusimama na kukita kambi mchana.
hypothesis: Katika hatua ya wahamiaji, chungu wa jeshi husafiri usiku na kusimama kambini wakati wa mchana.

source: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.
reference: Koloni huanza awamu ya kuhamahama wakati chakula kilichopo kimepunguka. Katika awamu hii, koloni hutengeneza viota visivyo vya kudumu ambavyo hubadilishwa kila siku.
hypothesis: Katika kipindi hicho, koloni hujenga viota vya muda ambavyo hubadilishwa kila siku.

source: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.
reference: Kila moja haya mabwawa ya kuhamahama au maandamano hudumu takriban siku 17.
hypothesis: Kila moja ya maonyesho hayo ya wahamiaji huendelea kwa siku 17 hivi.

source: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.
reference: Seli ni nini? Neno cell linatokana na neno la Kilatini "cella", linalomaanisha "chumba kidogo", na lilibuniwa mara ya kwanza na mtaalamu wa hadubini alipokuwa akitazama muundo wa dutu ya mwaloni.
hypothesis: Neno seli linatokana na neno la Kilatini "cella", linalomaanisha "chumba kidogo", na lilitengenezwa kwa mara ya kwanza na mtaalamu wa makombora aliyechunguza muundo wa kijiko.

source: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.
reference: Seli ni sehemu msingi ya vitu vyote vilivyo hai, na viumbehai wote wameundwa kwa moja au zaidi ya seli hizi.
hypothesis: Chembe ni kitengo cha msingi cha viumbe wote walio hai, na viumbe wote hufanyizwa na chembe moja au zaidi.

source: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".
reference: Seli ni msingi na muhimu kwa kujifunza hali ya maisha, na kwa kweli mara nyingi inatambulika kama vitalu vya kujenga maisha.
hypothesis: Kwa kweli, chembe ni muhimu sana katika kujifunza uhai hivi kwamba mara nyingi huitwa "vipande vya msingi vya uhai".

source: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.
reference: Mfumo wa neva hudumisha hali ya ndani kwa kutuma mipwito ya neva mwilini kote ili kudumisha mkondo wa damu pia bila usumbufu.
hypothesis: Mfumo wa neva unadumisha homeostasis kwa kutuma vichocheo vya neva kupitia mwili ili kudumisha mtiririko wa damu ukiendelea na bila kuvurugika.

source: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
reference: Mipwito hii ya neva inaweza kutumwa haraka sana mwilini kote ambayo huweka mwili salama dhidi ya hatari yoyote.
hypothesis: Nishati hizi za neva zinaweza kutumwa haraka sana katika mwili ambao husaidia kulinda mwili kutokana na tishio lolote linaloweza kutokea.

source: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
reference: Vimbunga hupiga sehemu ndogo ikilinganishwa na dhoruba zingine kali, lakini vinaweza kuharibu kila kitu kilichopo njiani mwao.
hypothesis: Vimbunga vinaathiri eneo dogo ikilinganishwa na dhoruba nyingine zenye nguvu, lakini vinaweza kuharibu kila kitu.

source: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
reference: Tufani hung’oa miti, kupasua mbao kutoka kwa majengo, na kurusha magari juu angani. Asilimia mbili ya tufani zenye vurugu zaidi hudumu kwa zaidi ya saa tatu.
hypothesis: Vimbunga vimepindua miti, vimepindua mabango ya majengo, na kuangusha magari angani.

source: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
reference: Dhoruba hizi za ajabu zina upepo wa hadi kilomita 480 kwa saa (mita 133 kwa sekunde; maili 300 kwa saa).
hypothesis: Dhoruba hizo zenye nguvu zina upepo wa kilomita 480 kwa saa.

source: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.
reference: Binadamu wamekuwa wakitengeneza na kutumia lenzi za kukuza kwa maelfu na maelfu ya miaka.
hypothesis: Kwa maelfu na maelfu ya miaka, wanadamu wamekuwa wakitengeneza na kutumia lensi za kuongeza ukubwa.

source: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.
reference: Hata hivyo, darubini halisi za kwanza zilitengenezewa Uropa katika karne ya 16.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, darubini za kwanza za kweli zilitengenezwa Ulaya mwishoni mwa karne ya 16.

source: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.
reference: Darubini hizi zilitumia mchanganyiko wa lenzi mbili kufanya vitu vilivyo mbali kuonekana kuwakaribu na kubwa.
hypothesis: Teleskopu hizo zilitumia lensi mbili ili kufanya vitu vilivyo mbali vionekane kuwa karibu zaidi na vikubwa zaidi.

source: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly
reference: Tamaa na ubinafsi siku zote zitakuwa nasi na ni hali ya ushirikiano kwamba wakati wengi wanafaidika siku zote kutakuwa na mengi ya kufaidi kwa muda mfupi kwa kutenda kiubinafsi.
hypothesis: Uchoyo na ubinafsi daima itakuwa na sisi na ni asili ya ushirikiano kwamba wakati wengi kufaidika daima kutakuwa na zaidi ya kupata katika muda mfupi kwa kutenda kwa ubinafsi

source: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.
reference: Kwa matumaini, watu wengi watagundua kwamba chaguo lao bora la kudumu ni kufanya kazi pamoja na wengine.
hypothesis: Tunatumaini kwamba watu wengi watatambua kwamba njia yao bora ya muda mrefu ni kufanya kazi pamoja na wengine.

source: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.
reference: Watu wengi huota kuhusu siku ambayo wanadamu wanaweza kusafiri kwa nyota nyingine na kuvumbua ulimwengu mwingine. Watu wengine hushangaa ni nini iko huko nje, wengine wanaamini kuwa wageni au maisha mengine yanaweza kuishi kwenye sayari nyingine.
hypothesis: Watu wengi wanaota juu ya siku ambapo wanadamu wanaweza kusafiri kwa nyota nyingine na kuchunguza dunia nyingine, baadhi ya watu wanajiuliza ni nini huko nje wengine wanaamini kwamba wa kigeni au maisha mengine yanaweza kuishi kwenye mmea mwingine.

source: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".
reference: Lakini, iwapo hili litawahi kutokea labda halitatokea kwa muda mrefu sana. Nyota zimetawanyika sana kiasi kwamba kuna matrilioni ya maili katikati ya nyota ambazo ni “majirani”.
hypothesis: Lakini, ikiwa jambo hilo litatukia, huenda halitatukia kwa muda mrefu sana. Nyota zimeenea sana hivi kwamba kuna trilioni za kilometa kati ya nyota ambazo ni "jirani".

source: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?
reference: Pengine siku moja, vitukuu wako watasimama juu ya ulimwengu wa kigeni wakiwaza kuhusu mababu zao wa zamani?
hypothesis: Labda siku moja, wajukuu wako watasimama juu ya ulimwengu wa kigeni wakijiuliza juu ya mababu zao wa kale?

source: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.
reference: Wanyama wametengenezwa kwa seli nyingi. Wao hula vitu na kuvimeng’enyea ndani. Wanyama wengi wanaweza kusonga.
hypothesis: Wanyama wameumbwa na chembe nyingi. Wanakula vitu na kuvichemsha ndani. Wanyama wengi wanaweza kusonga.

source: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).
reference: Ni wanyama tu walio na bongo (ingawa hata si wanyama wote walio nazo; kwa mfano, viwavi wa baharini hawana bongo).
hypothesis: Ni wanyama tu walio na ubongo (ingawa si wanyama wote walio na ubongo; kwa mfano, viumbe wa aina ya jellyfish hawana ubongo).

source: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.
reference: Wanyama hupatikana duniani kote. Wanachimba ardhini, wanaogelea kwenye bahari, na wanaruka angani.
hypothesis: Wanyama wanapatikana duniani kote, wanachimba ardhini, wanaogelea baharini, na kuruka angani.

source: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
reference: Seli ni sehemu ndogo ya kimuundo na ya kazi ya viumbe (vitu) hai.
hypothesis: Chembe ni kitengo kidogo zaidi cha usanifu na utendaji wa kiumbe hai (vitu).

source: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
reference: Seli linatokana na neno cella la Kilatini ambalo humaanisha chumba kidogo.
hypothesis: Kiini kinatokana na neno la Kilatini cella linalomaanisha chumba kidogo.

source: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
reference: Ukitazama vitu vyenye uhai chini ya hadubini, utaona kwamba vimeudwa kwa miraba au mipira midogo.
hypothesis: Ukiangalia viumbe hai chini ya darubini, utaona kwamba vimefanyizwa kwa mraba au mipira midogo.

source: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
reference: Robert Hooke, mtaalamu wa biolojia kutoka Uingereza, aliona miraba midogo kwenye kizibo kwa darubini.
hypothesis: Robert Hooke, mtaalamu wa biolojia kutoka Uingereza, aliona vipande vidogo-vidogo katika mkeka kwa kutumia darubini.

source: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
reference: Zilionekana kama vyumba. Alikuwa mtu wa kwanza kuona seli zilizokufa.
hypothesis: Walionekana kama vyumba. Alikuwa mtu wa kwanza kutazama seli zilizokufa

source: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
reference: Elementi na misombo zinaweza kusonga kutoka hali moja hadi nyingine na zikose kubadilika.
hypothesis: Vitu na misombo inaweza kuhamia kutoka hali moja hadi nyingine bila kubadilika.

source: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
reference: Nitrojeni kama gesi bado ina sifa sawa na nitrojeni oevu. Hali oevu nzito kiasi lakini molekyuli bado ni sawa.
hypothesis: Nitrojeni kama gesi bado ina mali sawa na nitrojeni ya maji. hali ya maji ni denser lakini molekuli bado ni sawa.

source: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
reference: Maji ni mfano mwingine. Msombo maji umeundwa kwa atomu mbili za hidrojeni na atomu moja ya oksijeni.
hypothesis: Maji ni mfano mwingine. Maji yaliyochanganywa hufanyizwa na atomu mbili za hidrojeni na atomu moja ya oksijeni.

source: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
reference: Ina muundo sawa wa kimolekyuli iwe ni gesi, kioevu, au mango.
hypothesis: Ina muundo uleule wa molekuli iwe ni gesi, kioevu, au thabiti.

source: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
reference: Ingawa hali yake ya mwili inaweza kubadilika, hali yake ya kikemikali inabaki ile ile.
hypothesis: Ingawa hali yake ya kimwili inaweza kubadilika, hali yake ya kemikali inabaki sawa.

source: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
reference: Wakati ni kitu ambacho kinatuzingira, na huathiri kila kitu tunachofanya, lakini ni ngumu kuelewa.
hypothesis: Wakati ni kitu kilicho kila mahali, na huathiri kila kitu tunachofanya, hata hivyo ni vigumu kuelewa.

source: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.
reference: Wakati umesomwa na wasomi wa kidini, kifalsafa, na kisayansi kwa maelfu ya miaka.
hypothesis: Kwa maelfu ya miaka, wasomi wa kidini, wanafalsafa, na wanasayansi wamejifunza kuhusu wakati.

source: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
reference: Sisi hupata saa kama msururu wa matukio unaopita kutoka wakati ujao kupitia wakati uliopo hadi kwenye wakati uliopita.
hypothesis: Tunaona wakati kuwa mfululizo wa matukio yanayopita kutoka wakati ujao kupitia wakati wa sasa hadi wakati uliopita.

source: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
reference: Saa pia ni jinsi tunavyolinganisha kipindi (urefu) cha matukio.
hypothesis: Wakati pia ni jinsi tunavyolinganisha urefu (urefu) wa matukio.

source: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
reference: Unaweza kuweka alama ya upitaji wa saa wewe mwenyewe kwa kuangalia marudio ya tukio la kimzunguko. Tukio la kimzunguko ni kitu ambacho hutukia tena na tena mara nyingi.
hypothesis: Unaweza kutaja kupita kwa wakati kwa kutazama tukio la mzunguko likijirudia mara kwa mara.

source: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.
reference: Tarakilishi leo hutumiwa kuumbua picha na video.
hypothesis: Leo kompyuta hutumiwa kudhibiti picha na video.

source: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.
reference: Michoro ya kisasa inaweza kujengwa kwenye kompyuta, na aina hii ya uhuishaji inazidi kutumiwa kwenye runinga na filamu.
hypothesis: Maonyesho magumu ya uhuishaji yanaweza kujengwa kwenye kompyuta, na aina hii ya uhuishaji inatumiwa zaidi na zaidi katika televisheni na sinema.

source: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.
reference: Muziki kwa kawaida hurekodiwa kutumia kompyuta tata ili kuchakata na kuchanganya sauti pamoja.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi muziki unarekodiwa kwa kutumia kompyuta za hali ya juu ili kusindika na kuchanganya sauti pamoja.

source: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
reference: Kwa muda mrefu wakati wa karne za kumi na tisa na ishirini, iliaminika wakazi wa kwanza wa Nyuzilandi walikuwa watu wa Maori, waliowinda ndege wakubwa walioitwa moa.
hypothesis: Kwa muda mrefu katika karne ya kumi na tisa na ya ishirini, iliaminika kwamba wakaaji wa kwanza wa New Zealand walikuwa watu wa Maori, ambao waliwinda ndege wakubwa wanaoitwa moas.

source: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
reference: Basi nadharia ikaanzisha wazo kwamba watu wa Maori walihama kutoka Polynesia katika Kundi Kubwa na kuchukua Nyuzilandi kutoka kwa Moriori, na kuanzisha jamii ya kilimo.
hypothesis: Nadharia hiyo ilianzisha wazo la kwamba watu wa Maori walihamia kutoka Polynesia katika Jeshi Kubwa na kuchukua New Zealand kutoka kwa Moriori, na kuanzisha jamii ya kilimo.

source: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
reference: Hata hivyo, ushahidi mpya unadokeza kwamba Moriori walikuwa kundi la Maori wa bara waliohama kutoka Nyuzilandi hadi Visiwa vya Chatham, na wakakuza utamaduni wao wenyewe wa kipekee na wenye amani.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, uthibitisho mpya unaonyesha kwamba Wamoori walikuwa kikundi cha Wamoori wa bara waliohamia kutoka New Zealand hadi Visiwa vya Chatham, wakiendeleza utamaduni wao wa kipekee na wenye amani.

source: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
reference: Kulikuwa pia na makabila mengine kwenye visiwa vya Chatham, ambao walikuwa Maori waliohamia Nyuzilandi.
hypothesis: Pia kulikuwa na kabila jingine katika visiwa vya Chatham hawa walikuwa Maori ambao walihamia mbali kutoka New Zealand.

source: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
reference: Walijiita Moriori kulikuwa na mapigano machache na mwishowe, Moriori wakauawa wote
hypothesis: Walijiita Moriori kulikuwa na mapigano machache na mwishowe, Moriori waliangamizwa

source: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
reference: Watu waliohusika kwa miongo kadhaa walitusaidia kuthamini uwezo na shauku zetu huku tukitathmini shida na hata kutofaulu kwa uwazi.
hypothesis: Watu ambao walikuwa wamehusika kwa miongo kadhaa walitusaidia kuthamini nguvu na shauku zetu huku wakichunguza kwa unyoofu magumu na hata kasoro.

source: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.
reference: Wakati wa kusikiliza watu wakishirikisha hadithi za kibinafsi, kifamilia au kishirika, tulipata ufahamu wa kale wenye thamani na baadhi ya watu ambao waliathiri utamaduni wa shirika kwa njia nzuri au mbaya.
hypothesis: Tulipokuwa tukisikiliza watu wakisimulia hadithi zao za kibinafsi, za familia, na za tengenezo, tulipata ufahamu wenye thamani kuhusu wakati uliopita na baadhi ya watu ambao waliathiri kwa njia nzuri au mbaya utamaduni wa tengenezo.

source: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.
reference: Wakati kuelewa historia ya mtu hakumaanishi kuelewa utamaduni, angalau huwasaidia watu kupata hisia za mahali waliko katika historia ya shirika.
hypothesis: Ingawa kuelewa historia ya mtu hakumaanishi kuelewa utamaduni, angalau husaidia watu kupata wazo la mahali wanapoanguka ndani ya historia ya shirika.

source: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
reference: Wakati wa kutathmini mafanikio na kufahamu kutofaulu, watu binafsi na watu wote wanaoshiriki hugundua kwa kina zaidi maadili, misheni na nguvu za uendeshaji za shirika.
hypothesis: Wakati wa kutathmini mafanikio na kuwa na ufahamu wa kasoro, watu mmoja-mmoja na watu wote wanaoshiriki hujifunza kwa kina zaidi maadili, utume, na nguvu zinazoendesha tengenezo.

source: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
reference: Kwa wakati huu, kukumbuka matukio ya awali ya tabia za ujasiriamali na mafanikio yaliyofuatia kulisaidia watu kuwa wazi kwa mabadiliko mapya na mwelekeo mpya wa kanisa la kienyeji.
hypothesis: Katika kisa hiki, kukumbuka visa vya zamani vya mwenendo wa ujasiriamali na mafanikio yaliyotokana nayo kuliwasaidia watu wawe tayari kwa mabadiliko mapya na mwelekeo mpya kwa kanisa la mahali hapo.

source: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
reference: Hadithi kama hizi za mafanikio zilipunguza hofu ya mabadiliko, huku zikiunda mielekeo chanya kuhusu mabadiliko wakati ujao.
hypothesis: Masimulizi kama hayo ya mafanikio yalisaidia kupunguza hofu ya mabadiliko, na wakati huohuo kuandaa mwelekeo mzuri wa kufanya mabadiliko katika siku zijazo.

source: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
reference: Mifumo inayobadilika ya fikira ni mbinu za utatuzi wa shida ambazo zinaunganisha maoni au nyanja tofauti ili kupata suluhisho.
hypothesis: Mbinu za kufikiri zinazounganishwa ni mbinu za kutatua matatizo zinazounganisha mawazo tofauti au nyanja mbalimbali ili kupata suluhisho.

source: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.
reference: Angazio la mtazamo huu ni kasi, mantiki na usahihi, pia utambuzi wa ukweli, kutumia tena mbinu zilizopo, kukusanya taarifa.
hypothesis: Akili ya mtazamo huu ni kasi, mantiki na usahihi, pia kutambua ukweli, kutumia tena mbinu zilizopo, kukusanya habari.

source: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
reference: Kipengele muhimu zaidi cha mtazamo huu ni: kuna jibu moja tu sahihi. Unafikiria majibu mawili tu, yaani sahihi au kosa.
hypothesis: Jambo muhimu zaidi katika mtazamo huu ni kwamba kuna jibu moja tu sahihi.

source: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.
reference: Aina hii ya fikira inahusishwa na taratibu fulani za kisayansi au kawaida.
hypothesis: Aina hii ya kufikiri huhusishwa na sayansi fulani au taratibu za kawaida.

source: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
reference: Watu wenye aina hii ya kufikiria wana mawazo ya kimantiki, wanaweza kukariri miundo, kutatua shida na kufanya majaribio ya kisayansi.
hypothesis: Watu wenye kufikiri kwa njia hiyo wanafikiri kwa njia inayofaa, wanaweza kukumbuka mifumo, kutatua matatizo, na kufanya majaribio ya kisayansi.

source: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.
reference: Kwa umbali wanadamu ndio spishi yenye talanta zaidi katika kusoma akili za wengine.
hypothesis: Wanadamu ni viumbe wenye talanta nyingi zaidi katika kusoma akili za wengine.

source: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.
reference: Hilo linamaanisha tunaweza kutabiri kile binadamu wengine wanachohisi, kukusudia, kuamini, kujua au kutamani kwa ufanisi.
hypothesis: Hilo linamaanisha kwamba tunaweza kutabiri kwa mafanikio mambo ambayo wanadamu wengine wanaona, wanakusudia, wanaamini, wanajua, au wanatamani.

source: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.
reference: Katika uwezo huu, kuelewa nia ya wengine ni muhimu. Huturuhusu kutatua uwezekano wa utata katika vitendo halisi vya kimwili.
hypothesis: Kati ya uwezo huo, kuelewa nia ya wengine ni muhimu sana, kwa kuwa kunatusaidia kutatua uwezekano wa kutoeleweka kwa matendo ya kimwili.

source: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.
reference: Kwa mfano, ikiwa ungeona mtu akivunja dirisha la gari, labda ungedhani alikuwa anajaribu kuiba gari la mtu usiyemjua.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, ukiona mtu akivunja dirisha la gari, huenda ukadhani alikuwa akijaribu kuiba gari la mgeni.

source: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
reference: Angehitaji kuhukumiwa tofauti ikiwa angepoteza funguo za gari lake na lilikuwa gari lake mwenyewe ambalo alikuwa akijaribu.
hypothesis: Angehitaji kuhukumiwa kwa njia tofauti ikiwa alikuwa amepoteza funguo za gari lake na alikuwa akijaribu kuvunja ndani ya gari lake mwenyewe.

source: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).
reference: MRI ni ya msingi wa fizikia inayoitwa nyuklia mwangwi wa sumaku (NMR), ambayo iligunduliwa katika 1930s na Felix Bloch (anayefanya kazi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Stanford) na Edward Purcell (kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Harvard).
hypothesis: MRI inategemea hali ya fizikia inayoitwa resonance ya sumaku ya nyuklia (NMR), ambayo ilipatikana katika miaka ya 1930 na Felix Bloch (anayefanya kazi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Stanford) na Edward Purcell (kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Harvard).

source: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
reference: Katika tasnifu hii, uga wa sumaku na wimbiredio husababisha atomi kutoa ishara ndogo za redio.
hypothesis: Katika sauti hiyo, uwanja wa sumaku na mawimbi ya redio husababisha atomu kutoa ishara ndogo za redio.

source: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.
reference: Katika mwaka wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, daktari wa kimatibabu na mtafiti wa kisayansi, aligundua msingi wa kutumia picha za mwangwi wa sumaku kama kifaa cha utambuzi wa kimatibabu.
hypothesis: Katika mwaka wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, daktari na mwanasayansi wa utafiti, aligundua msingi wa kutumia kupiga picha kwa kutumia mvuto wa sumaku kama chombo cha utambuzi wa kitiba.

source: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
reference: Miaka minne baadaye leseni ilitolewa, ambayo ilikuwa leseni ya kwanza ulimwenguni iliyotolewa katika sehemu ya MRI
hypothesis: Miaka minne baadaye patent ilitolewa, ambayo ilikuwa patent ya kwanza ulimwenguni kutolewa katika uwanja wa MRI.

source: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
reference: Mwaka wa 1977, Dak. Damadian alikamilisha ujenzi wa mdaki wa MRI wa mwili wote ambao aliuita “kisicho epukika”.
hypothesis: Mnamo 1977, Dakt. Damadian alimaliza ujenzi wa skanner ya kwanza ya MRI ya mwili wote, ambayo aliita Indomitable.

source: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.
reference: Mawasiliano mengi ya kisolandanifu huchochea muda wa kutafakari na kuitikia wengine.
hypothesis: Mawasiliano yasiyo ya kawaida huchochea wakati wa kutafakari na kuitikia wengine.

source: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.
reference: Huwaruhusu wanafunzi uwezo wa kufanya kazi kwa mwendo wao wenyewe na kudhibiti mwendo wa taarifa za mafundisho.
hypothesis: Inawawezesha wanafunzi kufanya kazi kwa mwendo wao wenyewe na kudhibiti mwendo wa habari ya kufundisha.

source: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)
reference: Isitoshe, kuna vizuizi vichache vya saa na uwezekano wa saa huru za kufanya kazi. (Bremer, 1998)
hypothesis: Kwa kuongezea, kuna vizuizi vichache vya muda na uwezekano wa saa za kazi rahisi (Bremer, 1998)

source: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.
reference: Matumizi ya intaneti na Wavuti wa Ulimwengu Wote unaruhusu wanafunzi kupata habari kila wakati.
hypothesis: Matumizi ya Intaneti na Mtandao wa Ulimwenguni pote huwawezesha wanafunzi kupata habari wakati wote.

source: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
reference: Wanafunzi wanaweza pia kupeleka maswali kwa waalimu wakati wowote wa siku na wanatarajia majibu ya haraka, badala ya kungojea mkutano wa uso-kwa-uso utakaofuata.
hypothesis: Wanafunzi wanaweza pia kuwasilisha maswali kwa walimu wakati wowote wa siku na kutarajia majibu ya haraka, badala ya kusubiri hadi mkutano ujao wa uso kwa uso.

source: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.
reference: Njia ya usasa ya kujifunza hutoa uhuru kutoka kwa kanuni mahsusi. Hakuna njia moja nzuri ya kujifunza.
hypothesis: Njia ya kujifunza ya baada ya kisasa hutoa uhuru kutoka kwa mambo ya kudumu. Hakuna njia moja nzuri ya kujifunza.

source: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.
reference: Kwa kweli, hakuna jambo hata moja zuri la kujifunza. Kujifunza hufanyika katika uzoefu kati ya mwanafunzi na maarifa yanayowasilishwa.
hypothesis: Kwa kweli, hakuna jambo lolote zuri la kujifunza.Kujifunza hufanyika katika uzoefu kati ya mwanafunzi na maarifa yaliyotolewa.

source: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.
reference: Uzoefu wetu wa sasa wa fanya-mwenyewe na uwasilishaji wa taarifa, vipindi vya televisheni vyenye msingi wa kujifunza, vinaonyesha pointi hii.
hypothesis: Uzoefu wetu wa sasa na maonyesho yote ya televisheni ya kufanya hivyo mwenyewe na maonyesho ya habari, yanayotegemea kujifunza yanaonyesha jambo hilo.

source: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.
reference: Kwa hivyo wengi wetu hujipata tukitazama kipindi cha runinga ambacho hutujulisha kuhusu mchakato au uzoefu ambao hatutawahi kushiriki au kutumia maarifa hayo.
hypothesis: Wengi wetu hujikuta tukitazama kipindi cha televisheni ambacho hutujulisha juu ya mchakato au uzoefu ambao hatutashiriki kamwe au kutumia ujuzi huo.

source: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
reference: Hatutawahi kukarabati gari lote, kujenga chemchemi katika ua letu la nyuma, kusafiri Peru kukagua magofu ya kale, au kubuni upya nyumba ya jirani.
hypothesis: Hatutawahi kurekebisha gari, kujenga chemchemi katika ua wetu wa nyuma, kusafiri kwenda Peru kuchunguza magofu ya kale, au kurekebisha nyumba ya jirani yetu.

source: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.
reference: Shukrani kwa viungo vya kebo za nyuzi za kioo chini ya bahari katika Uropa na satelaiti pana yenye bendi za masafa mapana, Greenland imeunganishwa vizuri na asilimia 93 ya watu wana ufikiaji wa intaneti.
hypothesis: Shukrani kwa chini ya bahari fiber optic cable uhusiano na Ulaya na satellite broadband, Greenland ni vizuri kushikamana na 93% ya idadi ya watu kuwa na upatikanaji wa mtandao.

source: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.
reference: Hoteli au wenyeji wako (ikiwa unakaa katika nyumba ya wageni au nyumba ya kibinafsi) ina uwezekano wa kuwa na WiFi au kompyuta iliyounganishwa kwenye intaneti, na makao yote yana duka la huduma za intaneti au mahali fulani palipo na WiFi ya umma.
hypothesis: Hoteli yako au wenyeji (ikiwa unakaa katika nyumba ya wageni au nyumba ya kibinafsi) labda watakuwa na wifi au PC iliyounganishwa na mtandao, na makazi yote yana kahawa ya mtandao au eneo fulani na wifi ya umma.

source: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.
reference: Kama ilivyosemwa hapo juu, ijapokuwa neno “Eskimo” limebaki kukubalika Marekani, linachukuliwa kuwa la dharau na wengi watu wengi wa Aktika wasiokuwa wa Marekani, haswa katika Canada.
hypothesis: Kama ilivyotajwa hapo juu, ingawa neno "Eskimo" linaendelea kukubalika nchini Marekani, watu wengi wasioishi Marekani katika eneo la Aktiki, hasa nchini Kanada, wanaliona kuwa neno lisilofaa.

source: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.
reference: Wakati unaweza kusikia neno hilo likitumiwa na Wenyeji wa Grinilandi, wageni wanapaswa kuepuka kulitumia.
hypothesis: Ingawa huenda ukasikia neno hilo likitumiwa na wenyeji wa Greenland, wageni wanapaswa kuepuka kulitumia.

source: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
reference: Wenyeji wa Greenland hujiita Inuit huko Canada na Kalaalleq (kwa wingi Kalaalit), Greenlander, katika Greenland.
hypothesis: Wakazi wa asili wa Greenland hujiita Wainuit nchini Kanada na Kalaalleq (Kalaallit wengi), mwenyeji wa Greenland, nchini Greenland.

source: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."
reference: Uhalifu, na uhasidi kwa wageni kwa jumla, haujulikani katika Grinlandi. Hata katika miji, hakuna “maeneo mabaya”.
hypothesis: Uhalifu, na uovu kuelekea wageni kwa ujumla, ni jambo lisilojulikana katika Greenland. Hata katika majiji, hakuna "maeneo magumu".

source: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.
reference: Hali ya hewa ya baridi labda ndiyo hatari tu ambayo wasiyojiandaa watakuta.
hypothesis: Huenda hali ya hewa baridi ndiyo hatari pekee ya kweli ambayo watu wasiojitayarisha watakabili.

source: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.
reference: Ikiwa utatembelea mji wa Greenland wakati wa msimu wa baridi (ukizingatia kuwa jinsi unavyokwenda kaskazini ndivyo inavyozidi kuwa baridi), ni muhimu kuleta mavazi ya kutosha ya joto.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unatembelea Greenland wakati wa majira ya baridi (kwa kuzingatia kwamba kadiri unavyoenda kaskazini, ndivyo utakavyokuwa baridi zaidi), ni muhimu kuleta mavazi yenye joto ya kutosha.

source: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.
reference: Siku ndefu sana katika msimu wa kiangazi zinaweza kupelekea shida za kupata usingizi wa kutosha na shida za kiafya zinazohusika.
hypothesis: Siku ndefu sana za majira ya joto zaweza kusababisha matatizo ya kupata usingizi wa kutosha na matatizo ya afya yanayohusiana nayo.

source: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.
reference: Wakati wa kiangazi, pia jihadhari na mbu wa Skandinavia. Ingawa hawaenezi magonjwa, wanaweza kukera.
hypothesis: Wakati wa majira ya joto, tahadhari na mbu wa kaskazini, ingawa hawaambuki magonjwa yoyote, wanaweza kuwa wenye kuchukiza.

source: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.
reference: Huku uchumi wa San Francisco ukiunganishwa nayo kuwa kivutio cha watalii cha kimataifa, uchumi wake ni mseto.
hypothesis: Ingawa uchumi wa San Francisco unahusishwa na kuwa kivutio cha utalii cha kiwango cha ulimwengu, uchumi wake ni tofauti.

source: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.
reference: Sekta kubwa zaidi za ajira ni huduma za kitaalamu, serikali, fedha, biashara, na utalii.
hypothesis: Sekta kubwa za kazi ni huduma za kitaalamu, serikali, fedha, biashara, na utalii.

source: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.
reference: Kuonyeshwa kwake mara kwa mara katika muziki, filamu, fasihi na utamaduni maarufu kumesaidia kuufanya mji huo na minara yake ijulikane ulimwenguni kote.
hypothesis: Maonyesho yake ya mara kwa mara katika muziki, filamu, fasihi na utamaduni wa watu wengi yamesaidia kufanya jiji hilo na alama zake zijulikane ulimwenguni pote.

source: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.
reference: San Francisko imekuza miundombinu kubwa ya watalii ambayo ni hoteli mikahawa, na vifaa vingi, vya kongamano vya hali ya juu.
hypothesis: San Francisco imejenga miundombinu mikubwa ya utalii yenye hoteli, mikahawa, na vifaa vya kusanyiko vya hali ya juu.

source: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.
reference: San Francisco pia ni mojawapo ya mahali bora nchini kwa vyakula vya Kiasia: Korea, Thai, India, na Japani.
hypothesis: San Francisco pia ni mojawapo ya maeneo bora nchini kwa vyakula vingine vya Asia: Kikorea, Thailand, India, na Kijapani.

source: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.
reference: Kusafiri kuenda Ulimwengu wa Walt Disney inawakilisha hija kuu kwa familia nyingi za Amerika.
hypothesis: Kusafiri kwenda Walt Disney World ni safari kubwa kwa familia nyingi za Marekani.

source: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.
reference: Ziara ya "kawaida" inajumuisha kutua kwenye Uwanja wa kimataifa wa ndege wa Orlando, kusafiri kwa basi hadi kwenye hoteli ya Disney, kukaa karibu wiki bila kutoka kwa miliki za Disney, na kurudi nyumbani.
hypothesis: Ziara "ya kawaida" inahusisha kuruka hadi Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kimataifa wa Orlando, basi hadi hoteli ya Disney, kutumia karibu wiki moja bila kuondoka mali ya Disney, na kurudi nyumbani.

source: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".
reference: Kuna tofauti zisizo na kikomo zinazopatikana, lakini hili linabaki kuwa jambo ambalo watu wengi humaanisha wanaposema wanaenda Ulimwengu wa Disney”."
hypothesis: Kuna tofauti zisizo na mwisho zinazowezekana, lakini hii inabaki kile ambacho watu wengi wanamaanisha wanapozungumza juu ya "kwenda Disney World".

source: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.
reference: Tiketi nyingi zinazouzwa mtandaoni kupitia tovuti za minada kama eBay au Craiglist ni zilizotumika kidogo za siku nyingi za kutembelea mbuga nyingi.
hypothesis: Tikiti nyingi zinazouzwa mtandaoni kupitia tovuti za mnada kama vile eBay au Craigslist hutumiwa kwa sehemu tikiti za park-hopper za siku nyingi.

source: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.
reference: Ingawa hii ni shughuli ya kawaida sana, imekatazwa na Disney: tiketi haziwezi kuhamishwa.
hypothesis: Ingawa hii ni shughuli ya kawaida sana, ni marufuku na Disney: tiketi haziwezi kuhamishwa.

source: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
reference: Ukitaji kambi wowote chini ya ukingo katika Grand Canyon unahitaji kibali cha sehemu za mashambani.
hypothesis: Kwa ajili ya kupiga kambi chini ya bonde la Grand Canyon inahitaji ruhusa ya kukimbilia mashambani.

source: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
reference: Vibali hupunguzwa kulinda korongo na hupatikana katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, mienzi nne kabla ya mwezi kuanza.
hypothesis: ruhusa ni mdogo kwa kulinda canyon, na kuwa inapatikana siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, miezi minne kabla ya mwezi kuanza.

source: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
reference: Kwa hivyo, idhini ya kurudi nchini kwa tarehe yoyote ya kuanza mwezi Mei inapatikana mnamo tarehe 1 Januari.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, kibali cha kurudi nchi kwa tarehe yoyote ya kuanza mwezi Mei kinapatikana tarehe 1 Januari.

source: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
reference: Nafasi katika maeneo maarufu zaidi, kama vile Bright Angel Campground karibu na Phantom Ranch, kwa jumla hujaa kwa maombi yanayopokewa siku ya kwanza yanapofunguliwa kwa uhifadhi.
hypothesis: Nafasi kwa ajili ya maeneo maarufu zaidi, kama vile Bright Angel Campground kando ya Ranch Phantom, kwa ujumla kujazwa na maombi kupokea tarehe ya kwanza wao kufunguliwa kwa uhifadhi.

source: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
reference: Kuna idadi ndogo ya vibali zilizohifadhiwa kwa maombi ya papo hapo zinazopatikana kwa hali ya fika kwanza, hudumiwa kwanza.
hypothesis: Kuna idadi ndogo ya ruhusa zilizohifadhiwa kwa maombi ya kutembea-in inapatikana kwa msingi wa kuja kwanza, kutumika kwanza.

source: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.
reference: Kuingia Afrika Kusini kwa gari ni njia ya ajabu ya kuona uzuri wote wa eneo vilevile kufika mahali kusiko katika njia za kawaida za watalii.
hypothesis: Kuingia Afrika Kusini kwa gari ni njia ya ajabu ya kuona uzuri wote wa eneo hilo na pia kupata maeneo yaliyo mbali na njia za kawaida za watalii.

source: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.
reference: Hii inaweza kufanywa kwenye gari la kawaida kwa mipango makini lakini inapendekezwa sana gari la 4 kwa 4 na sehemu nyingi zinaweza kufikika tu kwa gari la 4 kwa 4 lenye magurudumu mapana.
hypothesis: Hii inaweza kufanyika katika gari la kawaida na mipango ya makini lakini 4x4 inashauriwa sana na maeneo mengi ni kupatikana tu na msingi wa gurudumu kubwa 4x4.

source: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.
reference: Zingatia wakati wa kupanga kwamba ingawa Kaskazini mwa Afrika ni imara si nchi zote jirani zilizo imara.
hypothesis: Kumbuka wakati wa kupanga kwamba ingawa Afrika Kusini ni imara si nchi zote jirani ni.

source: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.
reference: Mahitaji na gharama ya visa hutofautiana toka nchi hadi nchi na huathiriwa na nchini unakotoka.
hypothesis: Mahitaji na gharama za visa hutofautiana kutoka nchi moja hadi nyingine na huathiriwa na nchi unayotoka.

source: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.
reference: Kila nchi pia ina sheria za kipekee zinazotaja ni vifaa vipi vya dharura unavyohitaji kuwa navyo garini mwako.
hypothesis: Pia kila nchi ina sheria za kipekee zinazohitaji vitu vya dharura vilivyopaswa kuwa ndani ya gari.

source: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.
reference: Victoria Falls ni mji ulioko katika sehemu ya magharibi mwa Zimbabwe, kuvuka mpaka kutoka Livingstone, ya Zambia, na karibu na Botswana.
hypothesis: Victoria Falls ni mji katika sehemu ya magharibi ya Zimbabwe, kando ya mpaka na Livingstone, Zambia, na karibu na Botswana.

source: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
reference: Jiji liko mara moja karibu na maporomoko ya maji ambayo ndiyo kivutio kikuu, lakini sehemu hii maarufu ya watalii huwatolea wanaotafuta kusisimka na kutembea maeneo mbali mbali fursa ya kukaa kwa muda mrefu.
hypothesis: Jiji hilo liko karibu na maporomoko ya maji, nayo ndiyo kivutio kikuu, lakini kitovu hiki maarufu cha watalii kinatoa fursa nyingi kwa watafutaji wa adventure na watalii kwa ajili ya kukaa kwa muda mrefu.

source: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
reference: Katika msimu wa mvua (Novemba hadi Machi), kiasi cha maji kitakuwa cha juu na maporomoko ya maji yatakuwa ya fujo sana.
hypothesis: Katika msimu wa mvua (Novemba hadi Machi), maji yatakuwa mengi zaidi na maporomoko yatakuwa makubwa zaidi.

source: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
reference: Umehakikishiwa kupata unyevunyevu ukiweza kuvuka daraja ama kutembea kando ya njia zinazozunguka karibu na Maporomoko.
hypothesis: Bila shaka utapata mvua ukivuka daraja au kutembea kwenye barabara zinazozunguka karibu na Mto Falls.

source: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
reference: Kwa upande mwingine, ni kwa sababu kiwango cha maji hususan ni kikubwa sana hivi kwamba mtazamo wako wa Maporomoko halisi ya Maji utazuiliwa – na maji yote!
hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, ni kwa sababu tu kiasi cha maji ni kikubwa sana kwamba kutazama kwako majivu halisi kutafichwa na maji yote!

source: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.
reference: Kaburi la Tutankhamun (KV62). Huenda KV62 ndilo kaburi maarufu zaidi katika Bonde, eneo la ugunduzi wa Howard Carter wa mazishi salama ya kifalme ya mfalme mchanga mnamo 1922.
hypothesis: Kaburi la Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 inaweza kuwa maarufu zaidi ya makaburi katika Bonde, eneo la Howard Carter ya 1922 ya ugunduzi wa karibu utupu wa kifalme wa mfalme mchanga.

source: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.
reference: Ikilinganishwa na makaburi mengine mengi ya kifalme, hata hivyo, kaburi la Tutankhamun halistahili sana kutembelewa, ni dogo sana na lina mapambo machache.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, ikilinganishwa na makaburi mengine mengi ya kifalme, kaburi la Tutankhamun si la kutembelea, kwa kuwa ni ndogo sana na lina mapambo machache.

source: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
reference: Mtu yeyote aliye na shauku ya kuona ushahidi wa uharibifu uliofanyiwa maiti ya kale wakati wa kujaribu kuitoa kutoka kwa jeneza atasikitika kuwa ni kichwa na mabega tu zinazoonekana
hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayependezwa kuona uthibitisho wa uharibifu uliotokea kwa mumia wakati wa majaribio ya kuuchukua kutoka kwenye kaburi atavunjika moyo kwa kuwa ni kichwa na mabega tu yanayoonekana.

source: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
reference: Utajiri mwingi wa kaburi haupo tena ndani yake, ila umepelekwa katika Jumba la Makumbusho la Misri huko Kairo.
hypothesis: Utajiri wenye kustaajabisha wa kaburi hilo hauko humo tena, lakini umepelekwa kwenye Jumba la Makumbusho la Misri huko Cairo.

source: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
reference: Ni bora wageni wasiokuwa na muda mrefu kutumia muda wao mahali pengine.
hypothesis: Wageni wenye wakati mdogo wangekuwa bora kutumia wakati wao mahali pengine.

source: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.
reference: Phnom Krom, kilomita 12 kusini magharibi mwa Siem Reap. Hekalu hili la kilimani lilijengwa mwishoni mwa karne ya 9, wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Yasovarman.
hypothesis: Phnom Krom, 12 km kusini magharibi ya Siem Reap. Hekalu hili juu ya kilima ilijengwa mwishoni mwa karne ya 9, wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Yasovarman.

source: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.
reference: Mazingira yenye huzuni ya hekalu na mwonekano wa ziwa la Tonle Sap ulifanya ukweaji kilima kuwa wa maana.
hypothesis: Hali mbaya ya hekalu na maoni juu ya ziwa la Tonle Sap hufanya kupanda mlimani kufanikiwe.

source: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.
reference: Ziara katika eneo hilo inaweza kujumuishwa kwa urahisi na safari ya ziwa katika boti.
hypothesis: Ziara ya eneo hilo inaweza kuunganishwa kwa urahisi na safari ya mashua kwenye ziwa hilo.

source: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
reference: Kibali cha Angkor kinahitajika ili kuingia katika hekalu kwa hivyo usisahau kubeba pasipoti yako unapoelekea Tonle Sap.
hypothesis: Ili kuingia hekaluni ni lazima upitishe njia ya Angkor, kwa hiyo usisahau kubeba pasipoti yako unapokwenda Tonle Sap.

source: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.
reference: Yerusalemu ni mji mkuu na mkubwa zaidi wa Israeli, ijapokuwa nchi nyingine nyingi na Umoja wa Mataifa haziutambui kama mji mkuu wa Israeli.
hypothesis: Yerusalemu ni mji mkuu na mji mkubwa zaidi wa Israeli, ingawa nchi nyingine nyingi na Umoja wa Mataifa haziutambui kuwa mji mkuu wa Israeli.

source: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
reference: Mji wa kale katika Vilima vya Judea una historia ya kusisimua ya maelfu ya miaka.
hypothesis: Jiji la kale katika Milima ya Yudea lina historia yenye kusisimua ya maelfu ya miaka.

source: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
reference: Mji ni mtakatifu kwa dini tatu zinazomwamini Mungu mmoja - Dini ya Kiyahudi, Ukristo na Uislamu, na hutumika kama kituo cha kiroho, kidini, na kitamaduni.
hypothesis: Jiji hilo ni takatifu kwa dini tatu za kishirikina - Uyahudi, Ukristo, na Uislamu, na ni kitovu cha kiroho, kidini, na kitamaduni.

source: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
reference: Kwa sababu ya umuhimu wa kidini wa mji huo, na hususan sehemu nyingi za maeneo ya Mji wa Zamani, Yerusalemu ni mojawapo ya sehemu kuu zinazowavutia watalii nchini Israeli.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya umuhimu wa kidini wa mji, na hasa maeneo mengi ya eneo la Jiji la Kale, Yerusalemu ni moja ya maeneo muhimu ya utalii katika Israeli.

source: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
reference: Yerusalemu ina sehemu nyingi za kihistoria, akiolojia na kitamaduni, pamoja na vituo vya ununuzi, mahoteli na migahawa mahariri na iliyojaa.
hypothesis: Yerusalemu lina maeneo mengi ya kihistoria, ya kiakiolojia, na ya kitamaduni, pamoja na vituo vya ununuzi, mikahawa, na mikahawa yenye shughuli nyingi.

source: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
reference: Ekuado inahitaji kwamba raia wa Cuba wapate barua ya mwaliko kabla ya kuingia Ekuado kupitia viwanja vya ndege vya kimataifa ama vituo vya uandikishaji kwenye mipaka.
hypothesis: Ecuador inahitaji raia wa Cuba kupokea barua ya mwaliko kabla ya kuingia Ecuador kupitia viwanja vya ndege vya kimataifa au vituo vya kuingia kwenye mpaka.

source: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
reference: Barua hii ni lazima ihalalishwe na Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Kiekwado, na itimize mahitaji fulani.
hypothesis: Barua hii lazima ihalalishwe na Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Ecuador, na itimize mahitaji fulani.

source: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
reference: Mahitaji haya yameandaliwa ili kutoa uhamiaji ulioandaliwa kati ya nchi zote mbili.
hypothesis: Mahitaji haya yameundwa ili kutoa mtiririko wa uhamiaji uliopangwa kati ya nchi hizo mbili.

source: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
reference: Wananchi wa Kuba ambao wana kadi ya kijani ya Marekani, wanaweza kutembelea ubalozi wa Ekuado ili kusamehewa hitaji hili.
hypothesis: Raia wa Cuba ambao ni wamiliki wa kadi ya kijani ya Marekani wanapaswa kutembelea Ubalozi wa Ecuador ili kupata msamaha wa mahitaji haya.

source: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
reference: Pasipoti yako lazima iwe halali kwa angalau miezi 6 zaidi ya tarehe zako za kusafiri. Tikiti ya safari ya kwenda na kurudi/kuendelea inahitajika ili kudhibitisha urefu wa kukaa kwako.
hypothesis: Pasipoti yako lazima iwe halali kwa angalau miezi 6 baada ya tarehe zako za kusafiri.

source: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.
reference: Ziara huwa bei nafuu kwa vikundi vikubwa, kwa hivyo kama uko peke yako au na rafiki mmoja tu, jaribu kukutana na watu wengine na kuunda kikundi cha watu wanne hadi sita kwa bei bora kwa mtu mmoja.
hypothesis: Ziara ni rahisi kwa vikundi vikubwa, kwa hiyo ikiwa uko peke yako au na rafiki mmoja tu, jaribu kukutana na watu wengine na ufanye kikundi cha watu wanne hadi sita kwa kiwango bora kwa kila mtu.

source: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.
reference: Hata hivyo, kwa kweli hii haifai kukosa kukupa wasiwasi, kwa sababu mara nyingi watalii huchanganywachanganywa ili kuyajaza magari.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, jambo hilo halipaswi kukusababishia wasiwasi, kwa sababu mara nyingi watalii husafirishwa ili kujaza magari.

source: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
reference: Inaonekana kweli kuwa njia zaidi ya kuwadanganya watu kuamini wanapaswa kulipa zaidi
hypothesis: Kwa kweli inaonekana kuwa ni njia zaidi ya kudanganya watu waamini wanapaswa kulipa zaidi.

source: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
reference: Juu ya mwisho wa kaskazini mwa Machu Picchu ni mlima ulio na mwinuko, mara nyingi ni uwanja wa nyuma wa picha nyingi za magofu.
hypothesis: Juu ya mwisho wa kaskazini wa Machu Picchu kuna mlima huu mkali, ambao mara nyingi huonyesha picha nyingi za magofu hayo.

source: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
reference: Inaonekana kutisha kutoka chini, na ni mwinuko mkali na mgumu, lakini watu wanaokusudiwa kuwa na hali nzuri ya mwili wanapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kuupanda kwa dakika kama 45.
hypothesis: Inaonekana kuwa yenye kuogopesha kidogo kutoka chini, na ni mwinuko mkali na mgumu, lakini watu wenye usawaziko zaidi wanapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kuufanya katika dakika 45 hivi.

source: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
reference: Hatua za mawe zimewekwa kando ya idadi kubwa ya vijia, na katika sehemu za mteremko nyaya za chuma hutoa reli za kushikiliwa inayounga mikono.
hypothesis: Hatua za mawe huwekwa kwenye sehemu kubwa ya barabara hiyo, na katika sehemu za mteremko zaidi kamba za chuma hutoa mwendo wa kutegemeza.

source: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
reference: Hilo likiwa limesemwa, tarajia kuishiwa na pumzi, na kuwa mwangalifu katika sehemu zenye mwinuko mno, haswa wakati wa unyevunyevu, kwa sababu inaweza kuwa hatari haraka.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, unapaswa kutarajia kupumua, na uwe mwangalifu katika sehemu zilizo nyembamba, hasa wakati wa mvua, kwa kuwa inaweza kuwa hatari haraka.

source: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
reference: Kuna pango ndogo karibu na juu ambalo lazima lipitwe, liko chini kabisa na la kubana sana.
hypothesis: Kuna pango ndogo karibu na juu ambayo lazima kupita kupitia, ni chini kabisa na tight tight.

source: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
reference: Kuona mandhari na wanyamapori wa Galapagos hufanywa vizuri kwa boti, kama vile Charles Darwin alivyofanya mnamo 1835.
hypothesis: Kuona maeneo na wanyama-mwitu wa Visiwa vya Galapagos hufanywa vizuri zaidi kwa mashua, kama vile Charles Darwin alivyofanya mwaka wa 1835.

source: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
reference: Zaidi ya meli 60 za kifahari husafiri kwenye maji ya Galapagos - zikiwa zenye saizi ya abiria 8 hadi 100.
hypothesis: Zaidi ya meli 60 za kusafiri zinasafiri katika maji ya Galapagos - zenye ukubwa wa abiria kuanzia 8 hadi 100.

source: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
reference: Watu wengi huhifadhi nafasi zao mapema sana (kwani kwa kawaida boti hizo hujaa wakati wa msimu wenye shughuli nyingi).
hypothesis: Watu wengi huweka nafasi zao mapema sana (kwa kuwa mashua huwa zimejaa wakati wa msimu wa juu).

source: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
reference: Hakikisha kwamba wakala unayetumia kupata uhifadhi ni mtaalamu wa Galapagos aliye na maarifa mengi ya aina tofauti tofauti za meli.
hypothesis: Hakikisha kwamba mwakilishi unayemtumia ni mtaalam wa Galapagos ambaye anajua vizuri aina mbalimbali za meli.

source: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
reference: Hii itahakikisha kwamba masilahi na/au vizuizi vyako vinalingana na meli inayowafaa zaidi.
hypothesis: Hii itahakikisha kwamba maslahi yako maalum na/au vizuizi vinalingana na meli inayofaa zaidi kwao.

source: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.
reference: Kabla ya Wahispania kuwasili katika karne ya 16, Chile kaskazini ilikuwa chini ya utawala wa Inca huku wenyeji Waarauka (Mapuche) wakiishi Chile ya kati na kaskazini.
hypothesis: Kabla ya Wahispania kufika katika karne ya 16, kaskazini mwa Chile lilikuwa chini ya utawala wa Inca wakati wenyeji wa Araucanians (Mapuche) waliishi katikati na kusini mwa Chile.

source: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.
reference: Mapuche pia walikuwa mojawapo ya vikundi huru asilia vya Marekani, ambavyo havikuzama kabisa katika sheria ya Kihispania hadi baada ya uhuru wa Chile.
hypothesis: Wamapuche pia walikuwa miongoni mwa vikundi vya mwisho vya wenyeji wa Amerika walioachwa huru, ambao hawakujiingiza kikamili katika utawala wa lugha ya Kihispania hadi baada ya uhuru wa Chile.

source: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.
reference: Ingawa Chile ilitangaza uhuru mnamo 1810 (katikati mwa vita vya Kinapoleoni ambavyo viliacha Uspanya bila serikali kuu thabiti kwa miaka kadhaa), ushindi kamili dhidi ya Uspanya haukufikiwa hadi 1818.
